1. The Service

2. Accounts

You can sign up with an email address or a Google account. You are responsible for managing your own account and password.

3. User Content

You retain the rights to the content you create. You must not upload content that violates the law or infringes the rights of others.

The Service is currently in a preparatory stage, and its features may change or it may be temporarily suspended. We will notify you of important changes in advance.

Acard Cloud is currently a closed beta that can only be accessed with an invite code. During the beta period, features may change frequently and errors may occur, and beta data may be migrated or reset before the official launch after prior notice. Invite codes may be used only by the person who received them and must not be sold or made public.

To the extent permitted by law, the Service is provided "as is".
